attribution: Spanish learning content structured according to the Plan Curricular del Instituto Cervantes (PCIC), A1–C2. Independent Wordfold selections; not certified, accredited or endorsed by Instituto Cervantes.
selectionPolicy: Choose communicative objectives first, then distinct useful senses. Counts are derived from enumerated selections, not English catalog quotas. Each level remains provisional; a vocabulary card does not demonstrate CEFR competence.

legacyCatalog.identityPolicy: Preserve all existing stable IDs and selected senses. Do not silently relevel or replace records.
legacyCatalog.coverageCredit: Existing topical records are retained and counted as available drafts, but not credited as validated coverage of these new functional objectives.
legacyCatalog.requiredFollowUp: Replace the legacy20 generic category rationales with individual sense-level evidence, then adjudicate borderline placements.

prototypePolicy.reason: Test fixtures, not level corpora. The A1 pie headword overlaps the legacy catalog; no automatic merging or promotion.
prototypePolicy.futureMigration: Any reused prototype sense needs a documented identity/duplicate decision and current review.

supplementalCatalog.baselineNote: Historical pre-review authoring snapshot. Root corrected exampleSurfaceForm En virtud de to En virtud del before independent reviews; current hashes are recorded by the level-aware review pipeline, not frozen here.

unmappedAreas: Full coverage of the20 existing topical PCIC classifications at each level is not yet selected; topic labels do not establish sense difficulty.
Higher cardinal numbers, fractions, ordinals, demonstratives, clitic pronouns and additional prepositional senses remain incomplete.
Connected reading/listening, interaction, writing, mediation, grammar practice, pronunciation/prosody and sociocultural competence cannot be completed by vocabulary cards alone.
Regional lexical variants, register alternatives and nonliteral senses need contextual comparative review, especially C1–C2.
No inference that all uncommon words belong to C2, or that a phrase first appears only at its proposed practice level.

reviewContract.identity: Each independent record must bind current content hashes, every entry ID and its reviewed level.
reviewContract.humanAttestations: Separate from AI coverage and never populated by owner approval or these inventory files.
reviewContract.release: Validated and independently AI-reviewed drafts may be exposed only through development preview; production release remains a separate decision.

authoringSequence: Retain existing500 A1 records and reconcile second-review corrections.
Author selected185-entry expansion, then independently review every record from Spanish and Slovak perspectives.
Resolve findings and rerun hash-bound coverage before enabling current preview batches.
Author the enumerated planned senses in objective-sized batches; investigate legacy duplicates before minting IDs.
Extend still-unmapped topics and individually adjudicate legacy level placements; do not mark the broad inventory complete until these are resolved.
